images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT IMAGE 1 (original bare cliffside painting), with IMAGE 2 used ONLY as a scale ruler; do not paint any people or magenta. Output exactly one 1536x1024 image. Make a tiny localized addition only. Add one DEAD farm cow lying limp on its side, with singed blackened hide, a charred flank, and stomach flayed open exposing dark red flesh. Soft contact shadow beneath it. CRITICAL SCALE CORRECTION: the previous attempt was over twice too large. The human figures in IMAGE 2 are only about 130 pixels tall. This 2.4 m cow must have a nose-to-rump length of approximately 180 pixels, NOT 400 pixels. Fit the ENTIRE cow, legs, tail and soft shadow within the small rectangle x=285 to 495, y=315 to 415. Center around (390,365) on the dirt shoulder, off the path centre, away from the cliff rim and at least 150 pixels from all borders. It is a small environmental prop, never a focal closeup. Match the existing elevated three-quarter camera, sunset key from screen upper-left, hand-drawn painted 2D style with tapered variable-weight dark contours, clean painted planes, restrained texture, readable silhouette and scene colors. Preserve IMAGE 1 verbatim everywhere outside that tiny cow-and-shadow rectangle: the precise original rocks, dirt strokes, grass, flowers, cliff, bridge, clouds, color and lighting. Keep flat pure #00ff00 void precisely unchanged. No flies, no added objects or burnt ground, no figures, no guides, no text, no framing or background changes.
